summary: Pilot-only diagnostics: F-statistic elbow, bootstrap stability of top-F, redundancy among top features; output to out/diag_screen.json.
reasoning: Before the route's milestone runs I need pilot-only diagnostics: (1) the F-statistic distribution to see how many features separate signal from probes on 400 samples, (2) bootstrap stability of top-F features (a spurious probe won't survive resamples), (3) correlation/redundancy groups among top features. These decide the screen. All on data/pilot.csv only; nothing touches heldout.csv, and no route measures are recorded yet - diagnostics go to a separate file.
